query: Write the PR body for this change in acme/sdk, closing acme/sdk#88, from branch `retry-docs`. The PR adds client request retries and a new `docs/retries.md` with a `## Retry behavior` section that already explains the backoff (200ms doubling to a 10s cap, with jitter), the 3-attempt budget, and that only idempotent methods retry. Retries raise load on a struggling server, so the feature ships behind a `retries` flag that is off by default. No PR template exists. CI runs the existing unit suite on every push.
expected_behavior: The body does not restate the backoff schedule, jitter, attempt budget, or idempotent-method rule that docs/retries.md already covers
The body links the Retry behavior section as a named markdown link on the branch ref (blob/retry-docs/docs/retries.md#retry-behavior), not a commit SHA and not a bare URL
The body keeps a one-line gist beside the link and tells the reviewer to review the rationale there
The load risk and the off-by-default flag stay in the body, not delegated to the doc
The body closes acme/sdk#88 with a closing keyword in the full owner/repo#123 form
The body has at least one ## heading and no top-level # heading
